name: Stock News API
tagline: Ticker-tagged stock and crypto news headlines for sentiment analysis and market apps
description: Stock News API delivers financial news articles and headlines tagged with stock and crypto tickers, with filters for tickers, topics, sentiment, and date ranges. Designed for developers building market dashboards, sentiment pipelines, and trading research tools that need structured news rather than general web content.

auth.details: API key via token query parameter (e.g. token=YOUR_API_KEY); self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available; exact request quotas vary by plan — check pricing page for current limits
pricing.paid_plans: Paid tiers for higher volume and advanced filters

use_cases: fetch latest news headlines for a stock ticker
filter crypto or equity news by sentiment
pull ticker-tagged articles for a date range
power a market sentiment dashboard from structured news
